This paper proved to be a good test of learners’ ability on the 9MA0 content and plenty of opportunity was provided for them to demonstrate what they had learnt.

Most learners accessed marks throughout the paper and there were many fully correct solutions to the earlier questions. The later questions offered more of a challenge with questions 13 and 14 being found the most difficult. The majority of learners produced robust proofs in question 11.
